BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'captured_at',now(),'owner',current_user,
'can_create_schema',has_database_privilege('postgres',current_database(),'CREATE'),
'public_usage',has_schema_privilege('postgres','public','USAGE'),
'public_create',has_schema_privilege('postgres','public','CREATE'),
'auth_usage',has_schema_privilege('postgres','auth','USAGE'),
'auth_id_select',has_column_privilege('postgres','auth.users','id','SELECT'),
'auth_confirmation_select',has_column_privilege('postgres','auth.users','email_confirmed_at','SELECT'),
'auth_uid_execute',has_function_privilege('postgres','auth.uid()','EXECUTE'),
'session_replication_role',current_setting('session_replication_role')
) AS privileges; COMMIT;
